cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Pocket Professor AI integrates on-device language-model inference with academic education and research workflows, providing students and researchers with offline tutoring, document analysis, literature support, academic writing assistance, citation generation, research-gap discovery, and project development tools.

test_prompts.prompt: A university student has limited internet access and needs to develop a research proposal. Explain how to structure the proposal, including the background, problem statement, objectives, research questions, methodology, and expected contribution. Keep the guidance practical and concise.

A researcher has uploaded a scholarly document and wants to understand its main argument. Explain a practical offline workflow for identifying the document's research problem, methodology, major findings, limitations, and possible research gaps without relying on cloud-based AI services.
